import math
def softmax(row):
    m = max(row)
    e = [math.exp(x - m) for x in row]
    s = sum(e)
    return [x / s for x in e]

def causal_mask(scores):
    return [[v if j <= i else float("-inf") for j, v in enumerate(row)] for i, row in enumerate(scores)]

scores = [[2.0, 1.0, 0.5], [0.5, 2.0, 1.0], [1.0, 0.5, 2.0]]
w = [softmax(r) for r in causal_mask(scores)]
print([[round(x, 4) for x in r] for r in w])

import math
def softmax(row):
    m = max(row)
    e = [math.exp(x - m) for x in row]
    s = sum(e)
    return [x / s for x in e]
def causal_mask(scores):
    n = len(scores)
    return [[scores[i][j] if j <= i else float("-inf") for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
scores = [[2.0, 1.0, 0.5], [0.5, 2.0, 1.0], [1.0, 0.5, 2.0]]
def leak(w):
    total = sum(w[i][j] for i in range(len(w)) for j in range(len(w[i])) if j > i)
    return round(total, 4)
unmasked = [softmax(r) for r in scores]
masked = [softmax(r) for r in causal_mask(scores)]
print(leak(unmasked), leak(masked))
